findings.description: When a command has no positional arguments, args is empty, so the all() check is trivially true and an empty 'Positional arguments' section heading is written for every such command's help output.
findings.rationale: Trigger: format help for any command or group with no Argument params. args == [], all([]) is True, so the section context manager runs and writes its heading even though records is empty. Mechanism: the guard that should suppress the section when there is nothing to list is missing; the old code used `if args:`. Impact: every argument-less command's --help shows a spurious, empty 'Positional arguments:' header, a visible regression on a common path.
